svg.text: py-spy record -o /h/flames-stock/TP09_formulas.svg --rate 50 --nonblocking -- python3 -c from openpyxl import load_workbook wb = load_workbook('output/monthly_operations_report.xlsx', data_only=False) ws = wb['Reconciliation'] n = sum(1 for row in ws.iter_rows() for c in row if isinstance(c.value, str) and c.value.startswith('=')) print('formulas:', n) wb.close()
